parts.script:
Alice: Hey, Tom! Do you have any plans for the weekend?  
Tom: Not yet, Alice. I was thinking about going somewhere out of town. Any suggestions?  
Alice: How about a trip to the mountains? I heard the weather will be great.  
Tom: That sounds fantastic! We could go hiking and maybe have a picnic.  
Alice: Yes! I can bring some snacks. Do you have a place in mind?  
Tom: I've been to Maple Ridge before; it has some beautiful trails and a lovely lake.  
Alice: Maple Ridge sounds perfect! What time do you want to leave?  
Tom: How about we leave early Saturday morning? We can beat the traffic.  
Alice: Sounds good! Should we invite Mark and Sarah too?  
Tom: Definitely! The more, the merrier. I’ll text them.  
Alice: Great! I’ll pack our lunch and some drinks.  
Tom: Awesome! It’s going to be a fun weekend!  
Alice: I can’t wait!  
Tom: Me neither! Let’s finalize everything tonight.

questions.explanation: Alice suggests going to the mountains.

questions.explanation: They decided on Maple Ridge as their destination and to leave early Saturday.

questions.explanation: Tom mentions planning to go hiking during their trip.

questions.explanation: Tom suggests inviting Mark and Sarah.

questions.explanation: Alice mentions she will bring snacks.

questions.explanation: Tom suggests leaving early to avoid traffic.
